name: The web
description: The web: safe HTML templates, Eve in the browser, and the Eve Web Portal evewp, written in Eve with no JavaScript, as the last and hardest test of the language. Level 7 is the server: evedb, the Eve machine with DuckDB inside, and the portal. The development clients evetx (terminal) and eveux (native window) belong to level 6.
